release.title: V1 Chrome extension
release.detail: Manifest V3; TinyActors WASM in sidepanel-owned worker; BYOK Gemini; local IndexedDB; screenshots; voice or typed observations; editable previews; work packet download.

release.title: V2 embedded publication widget
release.detail: Same charts, model tools, domain contracts and UI component hierarchy; different DOM, capture, credential and download adapters. Mobile-first bottom sheet.

release.title: V3 optional team host
release.detail: Optional one-process self-hosted server with SQLite and local files for identity, shared sessions and dispatch. No external object store.

release.title: Explicit V1 exclusions
release.detail: No publishing, no remote coding agent invocation, no shared accounts, no server, no cross-origin subframe DOM access, no visual layout CSS edit automation; unresolved design notes export as tasks.

context.title: Chrome extension side panel
context.responsibility: Owns visible UI, Gemini API connection, chrome.storage.session-backed browser-session credential vault, microphone MediaStream, IndexedDB, download orchestration and transport to worker. No privileged page DOM access.

context.title: TinyActors WASM worker
context.responsibility: Runs the bundled @tinyactors/wasm host and compiled SCXML charts; all statechart events are deterministic messages, external effects only through adapters. Restartable from persisted domain events.

context.title: Content script per top-level document
context.responsibility: Accesses live DOM, highlights/anchors text, applies/reverts text-node patches, reports page context and page mutations. Never receives Gemini key or microphone frames.

context.title: Manifest V3 service worker
context.responsibility: Registers onInstalled/onStartup/action handlers synchronously; opens side panel, brokers activeTab/script/capture API when necessary; has no business state or assumption of persistence.

context.title: Google Gemini API
context.responsibility: Processes submitted speech/text/screenshots/context; never trusted for authoritative DOM state; may return model text and native function calls.

context.title: Extension IndexedDB
context.responsibility: Versioned session data and optional explicitly attached images; no raw audio, API key, password, token or full-page HTML. Schema upgrades are transactional.

channel.policy: Accept only versioned event envelopes; validate type, correlation, and per-session sequence. No key, raw audio or screenshot bytes in actor datamodel.
Target exact active tab and document nonce. Validate operation allowlist; actor ID/correlation required; never eval HTML/script.
Only privileged operations (capture, injection) with per-tab activeTab authority; timeout with typed fault.
Credential only in extension-owned memory; redact/sanitize before send; no retries for ambiguous side effects; respect model call IDs.
Durable events persist before user-visible success; all updates are version checked, no implicit cloud sync.

field.name: schemaVersion
field.description: Must equal 1; reject incompatible major versions.

field.name: hostKind
field.description: Transport host identity: extension or embedded. Used to choose platform-specific page identity guards; not a Gemini or I/O processor payload.

field.name: tabId
field.description: Chrome-only tab ID required for extension page-scoped DOM/capture operations; must be absent in embedded mode.

field.name: documentNonce
field.description: Random host-generated document epoch nonce, required for page-scoped DOM/capture on both extension and embedded. No optional inference from URL alone.

field.name: payload
field.description: Typed operation payload, validated against generated JSON Schema.

field.name: expectedRevision
field.description: Optional optimistic concurrency precondition for state mutations.

runtime.invariant: Reject unknown schemaVersion, hostKind, kind, IO ID or reply actor. Page-scoped requests always require documentNonce; extension additionally requires tabId. Embedded requests must not carry Chrome tabId. Global credential/context operations require neither.
Deduplicate messageId within session; for mutating operations persist outcome before acknowledging success.
On navigation, dispose per-document content actor; revoke pending requests, invalidate old DOM previews, retain accepted revisions as historical records.
A timeout produces a typed fault; late successful responses are ignored only after reconciliation of any local mutation.
Gemini FunctionCall IDs are correlated exactly to FunctionResponse; model arguments cannot supply host-only fields.
DOM mutation is committed only after the content script returns the post-write text hash; persist an accepted revision separately from ephemeral preview state.
Never expose key or audio in model-call traces, SCXML datamodel, ZIP packets, console logs or inter-context messages.
A chart loaded from an extension bundle is trusted code; no dynamic chart/script loading from visited pages or model replies.

platform.policy: User opens panel via action icon; grant activeTab, inject content script on user invocation; restricted URLs enter readonly/unsupported state.
No broad all_urls by default. If temporary host authority expires, request explicit reactivation before DOM or screenshot operation.
Persist event log and current domain state on each durable user action, not on service worker shutdown. Rehydrate actor host when side panel reopens.
Use getUserMedia() in side panel context, not MV3 worker. Release all tracks when panel closes, session stops, permission changes or device ends.
Gemini HTTPS/Live WebSocket called directly from trusted extension sidepanel in BYOK mode; never via content script.
Use chrome.tabs.captureVisibleTab for active tab with authority; screenshot held in memory and included in packets only on explicit Attach.
Generate ZIP as Blob in trusted extension page, use chrome.downloads or anchor download; name deterministically; never ask for server endpoint.
Compile XML SCXML charts into one bundled TinyActors image using documented package toolchain; keep XML sources in repository; host dispatchers resolve each declared IO processor.

component.title: Side panel shell
component.behavior: Resizes as native Chrome side panel; single column; clear top/middle/bottom landmarks; no viewport overlay except page highlight.

component.title: Header
component.behavior: Title and single Explore icon; settings is an icon-only button with tooltip and aria-label. No repeated project data.

component.title: Page context
component.behavior: Hostname and page title, tiny connection badge, optional persona chip; clicking opens context sheet.

component.title: Annotation list
component.behavior: Scrollable compact list: one line title, one line excerpt, one status icon. Sorted DOM order by default; active row visibly selected. Show count, filter only on demand.

component.title: Annotation row
component.behavior: Click selects anchor, scrolls page into view and opens details; keyboard arrows move focus without trapping.

component.title: Focused detail
component.behavior: Single expanded item: review note, proposed copy and rationale; no second full page editor; sticky bottom primary action if needed.

component.title: Change proposal
component.behavior: Plain text before/after, visually distinct; original never replaced in persisted audit; text long enough scrolls without nested overflow.

component.title: Preview toggle
component.behavior: Click previews on host page after hash and document validation; second click reverts. Show immediate loading, success or typed error.

component.title: Keep revision
component.behavior: Accept selected revision locally, never automatically publish. Kept item remains editable and undoable; persist before showing success.

component.title: Feedback composer
component.behavior: Bottom anchored text field, attach/voice icons, send button. Use typed input if microphone unavailable; Enter sends; Shift+Enter newline.

component.title: Voice capture
component.behavior: Push-to-talk optional; explicit recording state, selected microphone, input meter and Stop. On loss pause and offer switch/typing.

component.title: Export control
component.behavior: Single primary action Download packet, accompanied by kept and unresolved counts; no packet-level approval or artificial handoff configuration.

component.title: Settings sheet
component.behavior: Gemini API key setup/test/forget, microphone choice and privacy; never show key after entry; no password persistence V1.

component.title: Context sheet
component.behavior: Persona selector, project brief and source snippets, revision badges, no free model instructions in trusted policy layer.

component.title: Technical Explorer
component.behavior: Secondary developer view, not default review workspace. Deep-link to actor/IO contract IDs from selected annotation.

component.title: Empty and error states
component.behavior: Separate no-annotations, unsupported page, missing key, offline, missing permission, lost mic, quota, stale target and storage-full messages with next action.

token.name: panel.preferredWidth
token.usage: Mockup width; native side panel user-resizable

token.name: control.minTarget
token.usage: Desktop icon control, 44px on embedded touch V2

token.name: list.maxHeight
token.usage: Initial mockup limit; should flex with viewport on production

token.name: motion.duration
token.usage: Non-essential hover/selection transitions; reduced motion disables

ui.rule: At 360px wide and 600px tall, selected item context, proposal preview/keep, composer and export remain reachable without horizontal scroll.
Keyboard: Tab visits controls logically, Escape exits capture/overlay/modal, Enter activates selected control, Shift+Enter inserts newline.
No color-only status. Use icon + status text accessible through label; actual text contrast at least WCAG AA.
Annotating does not require a model key; generating proposals or voice model requests prompt for key.
Single active suggestion in detail pane; list provides compact awareness without four competing action areas.
Failure notifications have a readable cause, retry where safe, and text-input fallback where applicable.
All overlay/selection visuals are extension-controlled, pointer-transparent unless explicitly selecting, and removed when review inactive.
Review area has exactly one visually dominant action per stage; model settings, persona and Explorer are secondary.

storage.name: tinyactors-review-v1

store.rule: Unique sessionId; URL canonicalized without fragments, query stripped of known tokens; no page body persisted.
No screenshots or full HTML by default.
Coordinates expressed in CSS pixels with devicePixelRatio/scroll offsets captured; DOM locator must be verified before mutation.
Only finalized user text, not unconfirmed partial transcripts.
Generated text remains a proposal; never write HTML/script.
Every keep/undo/dismiss has new immutable revision event.
Selected personas, briefs, sanitized excerpts; user-managed versioning.
Only durable domain events; no raw audio, credential, model chain-of-thought, hidden page data.
Saved only when editor chooses Attach; enforce size budget and purge with review.
Can be rebuilt from events if snapshot schema incompatible; no browser MediaStream or credential.
Only metadata; downloaded ZIP belongs to user and cannot be remotely deleted.

storage.rule: All stores scoped to extension origin and local browser profile; no server sync in V1.
Raw audio, transient PCM frames, device labels before permission, provider API keys and ephemeral model tokens are prohibited from IndexedDB.
IndexedDB schema migration must copy data transactionally or roll back and preserve the old store; new schemaVersion increments.
On QuotaExceeded, do not discard text annotations; prevent optional image attachment and offer export/delete controls.
Clear review deletes associated anchors, observations, suggestions, previews, snapshots and opted-in images; exported files outside application remain user-managed.

case.title: Install and open without backend
case.when: activate action on ordinary https page
case.then: side panel opens, script injection after user gesture, no network to custom backend

case.title: Restricted site
case.then: show unsupported site; no injection attempt; no crash

case.title: Temporary permission
case.then: show Reactivate control; never broad host permission request silently

case.title: DOM target stable
case.then: anchor includes page fingerprint, CSS locator, text hash and geometry

case.title: DOM hash mismatch
case.then: fail PRECONDITION_FAILED; no mutation; mark suggestion stale

case.title: React rerender
case.then: mark preview invalidated and keep accepted revision history; do not silently repatch new node

case.title: Preview and undo
case.then: original text restored; readback hash matches original; no accepted revision recorded

case.title: Keep and export
case.given: one kept copy change, one unresolved note
case.then: valid XML/XSD ZIP; both items represented correctly; no second approval screen

case.title: Zero key annotation
case.then: offline annotations work; model suggestion prompts key setup

case.title: BYOK credential
case.then: test uses direct provider; raw key absent from logs, content script, storage and ZIP

case.title: Wrong BYOK key
case.then: show invalid credential state without deleting existing reviews

case.title: Native model function call
case.given: Gemini asks to inspect page context
case.then: arguments validated, host adds anchor, typed IO invoked and result correlated to FunctionCall id

case.title: Model proposes script
case.given: Gemini returns replacement containing markup or JS action
case.then: schema/allowlist rejects operation; no evaluation or HTML injection

case.title: Clarification via native dialogue
case.when: Gemini asks question, user pushes back
case.then: transcript/intent recorded in ordinary turns; no invented ClarificationResult schema

case.title: Persona revision provenance
case.then: show original persona revision/digest; no silent rewrite

case.title: Audio stopped on closing
case.then: all MediaStream tracks stopped; socket closed; raw bytes not persisted

case.title: Device unplug
case.then: transmission pauses, device lost shown; offer manual alternate or typed fallback

case.title: Microphone denied
case.then: UI explains permission and offers text composer; no repeated prompt loop

case.title: Provider disconnected
case.then: keep observations and accepted patches; typed text fallback; optionally reconnect by user action

case.title: Capture privacy
case.then: redaction or exclusion before provider send; unredactable capture is blocked

case.title: Storage full
case.then: no partial image commit; annotations preserved; notify and offer download/delete

case.title: Restart recovery
case.then: restore annotations, revisions and persona; mic/socket/key (session-only) reinitialized only on gesture

case.title: Multi-tab isolation
case.when: select and preview in tab A, switch to tab B
case.then: no patch applied to B; review identity includes tab/document nonce

case.title: Work-packet neutrality
case.when: grep files for TinyActors, actor state and credentials
case.then: packet contains only target DOM context, changes, constraints and evidence; no runtime framework requirements

case.title: Accessibility and narrow panel
case.then: no horizontal overflow; focus visible and labels non-color-only

case.title: No automatic publish
case.then: only generates downloadable archive; no actual source repository or production site modified

case.title: Corrupted restore
case.given: snapshot hash invalid or from older chart version
case.then: rebuild materialized state from domain events; preserve user data, show recoverable warning

case.title: Revision conflict
case.given: two asynchronous proposals for same anchor
case.then: version conflict surfaced; no overwriting newer accepted state

milestone.title: Manifest, contexts and actor runtime boot
milestone.gate: Extension opens and runs TinyActors WASM from packaged code with no network except provider after key setup.

milestone.title: Platform I/O: DOM selection/preview/revert
milestone.gate: DOM mutation exact-hash guards and rollback tested on vanilla and React fixture.

milestone.title: IndexedDB, event history and recovery
milestone.gate: All user observations and accepted revisions survive side-panel and browser restart; no secret persistence.

milestone.title: Focused UI matching v1.4 reference
milestone.gate: Component hierarchy, tokens, keyboard access and narrow-panel acceptance tests pass.

milestone.title: Gemini BYOK and structured tool routing
milestone.gate: Key test/forget and native function call correlation pass; no arbitrary code reaches DOM.

milestone.title: Microphone lifecycle and visual evidence
milestone.gate: Device unplug, revoked permission, no supported capture and socket close gracefully degrade.

milestone.title: XML work-packet export and packaging
milestone.gate: Packet conforms to XSD, integrity checks pass, framework-agnostic, no server required.

milestone.title: End-to-end independent-agent handoff trial
milestone.gate: Fresh coder given only full implementation ZIP can build V1 and pass contract/interaction smoke tests.
